_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public records and reporting. Legal statuses and roles are time-bound to the cited source dates; allegations are identified as charges. Public senior figures only, with country-level regions; no operational route or enforcement-weakness information. No photos included because reliable reuse licenses and credits were not verified.

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions Cartel de Jalisco Nueva Generacion Leaders Under Counterterrorism Authorities

people.name: Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes
people.roleLabel: Deceased founder and former leader of CJNG; DOJ states he was killed on or about February 22, 2026

evidence.claim: DOJ describes his co-founding of the Jalisco-based CJNG and a 2015 Mexican military pursuit involving him; this is historical country association, not a precise operating site.

events.title: Death during Mexican military operation
events.summary: A DOJ-hosted June 25 court filing states Oseguera Cervantes was killed on or about February 22, 2026. The August 5 DOJ release also identifies him as CJNG’s former leader and confirms his death in February. The event date is approximate as stated in the filing.
